The '''Deaons''', also known by the derogatory name "'''Gimmers'''," were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Gimmel/Legends|Ord Gimmel]]. They made up 42% of the planet's population, and were the primary labor force in its factories.<ref name="Strongholds" />

==Biology and appearance==
The Deaons were descended from [[Human/Legends|humans]]. Over time, however, they evolved [[Color/Legends|yellow]] skin and longer, more spindly limbs.<ref name="Strongholds" />

==Culture==
Deaons spoke their mind publicly and often. As a result, their culture appeared to lack "social niceties" and manners, though the Deaons were also unusually forgiving.<ref name="Strongholds" />
